lines: COMMITS on track/p-held-nav-guard (not pushed, rebased or landed), on 9e166fc. dd113bc fix(admin): ask before leaving a screen with an unsettled held write. 5c5f9ce fix(admin): settle review-70 notes on the held-write leave guard (the follow-up to review-70). Land both together. Frontend, plus one CLAUDE.md sentence in dd113bc. whats-new/**, fund lifecycle files and copy outside the dialog are untouched.

ROUTER (dd113bc): useBlocker needs a data router. AppProviders no longer renders a router. ClientShellRoot wraps it in BrowserRouter, which gives the same tree as before. AdminShellRoot holds a module-level createBrowserRouter([{ path: '*', element: <RouteErrorBoundary><AdminApp/></RouteErrorBoundary> }]) rendered by RouterProvider. The buildRouter <Routes> tree is unchanged. A crash outside the route boundary now shows the 'unknown' ErrorState instead of a blank page.

GUARD (features/admin/shared/HeldWriteLeaveGuard.tsx, rendered once by AdminApp). useBlocker blocks only when all of these hold: signed in (a ref set during render); a hold that leaves with the screen is unsettled, read live via heldWriteKeepingOnLeave(); the pathname changes; the next path is not public (/login, /splash); and the next location's state does not carry leaveHeldWrite: true (LEAVE_HELD_WRITE). If the hold settles while the dialog is open and the session is still signed in, the guard calls proceed(), so the click is honoured (5c5f9ce, F3). If the session ended, it calls reset().

DIALOG: 'Stay on this page?'. Stay is the cancel (also Escape, scrim, Close, Android Back). 'Leave anyway' is danger tone. Stored hold (5c5f9ce, F2): 'A save is not confirmed yet. Leaving keeps it in this tab, and you can come back to this page to check it.' Any page-only hold: 'A save is not confirmed yet, and it is kept on this page only. If you leave, it cannot be checked again, so check the record before you enter it again.'

PAGE-ONLY CORRECTION (dd113bc): many useHeldWrite callers pass no persistence: maturity actions, SIP create/edit/close/early exit, application decide, app config publish, fund holdings exit. The registry stores whether each hold is page-only (hold !== null && !persisted). 'Unsettled' uses the p-lows registry rule (hold or unreadable hold), not useUnloadGuard, which fires only for unsaved holds.

REGISTRY (unsettledHeldWrites.ts after 5c5f9ce). useMarkUnsettledHeldWrite(isUnsettled, isKeptOnPageOnly) reads SurvivingHeldWriteScope (a context, default false). heldWriteKeepingOnLeave() returns 'none' | 'tab' | 'page' and ignores surviving holds; useHeldWriteKeepingOnLeave() is its hook. useHasUnsettledHeldWrite() counts every hold, surviving ones included, for What's new and the maturity prompt.

F1 (5c5f9ce): AdminFrame wraps MaturityDuePrompt in <SurvivingHeldWriteScope value>. Its action dialogs stay mounted across screens, so their holds no longer make the guard ask, give the page-only line or re-ask on Back. They still hold back What's new and the maturity prompt. Screen-level maturity dialogs (ClientMaturitySection on the client page) are not in the scope and are still guarded.

F4 (5c5f9ce): FundCreateScreen's held-notice action 'Check the fund list' calls navigate('/funds', { state: LEAVE_HELD_WRITE }). It is the only held-notice action that navigates: grep onReload over features/admin finds no other. The fund-create hold is persisted, so /funds/new restores it. No dedicated test (not asked).

PAYMENT SHEET: PaymentSheetScreen calls useMarkUnsettledHeldWrite(waiting.size > 0, recorder.unsaved.size > 0) (dd113bc). It is now tested in 5c5f9ce. As a result, What's new and the maturity prompt also wait while sheet rows are unsettled.

ANDROID BACK: no NativeBackCoordinator change. Its navigations go through the data router, so the blocker catches them. Not guarded: the exitApp branch, taken only on /overview, /login or /splash with no history; no held write lives there outside an overlay.

COMPAT (rule 11, finding-14): no request or response shape, route, error code, header, cookie or stored key change. The registry is memory only and the navigation state is in-memory history state. Released APKs carry their own bundles; an images-only rollback restores the old frontend. The client is unchanged in behaviour; cross-target check: none.

TESTS. HeldWriteLeaveGuard.test.tsx, 6 tests, with a real SessionProvider, useHeldWrite, NativeBackCoordinator and admin back policy under createMemoryRouter: (1) a sidebar link asks with the page-only line; Stay stays; Leave anyway goes. (2) No hold: the link passes, and a confirmed write's own redirect passes. (3) Sign-out is never held, even with the held form mounted. (4) Android Back asks with the 'in this tab' line; a second Back closes the dialog; Leave anyway goes to the parent. (5, new) A write still sending settles while the dialog is open: the click goes through. (6, new) A frame hold under SurvivingHeldWriteScope: no question on leaving, and the prompts stay held back.

TESTS, continued. PaymentSheetScreen.test.tsx (new): a row sent without a confirmed reply makes the guard ask; the session mock gains status 'authenticated'. AdminShellRoot.test.tsx (new): mocks only createAdminRuntime (restore returns an admin; http requests stay pending). It renders AdminShellRoot (module router, lazy routes, AppProviders, AdminFrame), shows /account, follows 'Read what's new' to /account/whats-new, and checks there is no dialog. It has a 15 s budget for two lazy loads.

F6 (5c5f9ce): the Request signal stub (jsdom's AbortSignal fails undici's Request check in React Router's data-router navigation) moved to src/app/routing/dataRouterTestSupport.ts. dropRequestSignalsInThisFile() installs it in beforeAll and removes it with vi.unstubAllGlobals() in afterAll. Three test files call it.

(1) /client-values/individual: hold an adjustment as Not confirmed (drop the reply), click a sidebar item: the 'keeps it in this tab' line, URL unchanged. COMMIT on track/p-held-nav-guard (not pushed, rebased or landed), on 9e166fc: dd113bc fix(admin): ask before leaving a screen with an unsettled held write. Frontend plus one CLAUDE.md sentence. whats-new/**, fund lifecycle files, copy outside the dialog: untouched.

WHY THE ROUTER CHANGED: useBlocker (and unstable_usePrompt) throw outside a data router, and both shells used BrowserRouter inside AppProviders. AppProviders no longer renders a router. ClientShellRoot wraps it in BrowserRouter (same tree as before, so no client change). AdminShellRoot now holds a module-level createBrowserRouter([{ path: '*', element: <RouteErrorBoundary><AdminApp/></RouteErrorBoundary> }]) rendered by RouterProvider; AdminApp is the old shell body, and the buildRouter <Routes> tree is unchanged under the splat route. The router is module level, not useState, so StrictMode cannot create a second router with its own popstate listener. RouteErrorBoundary keeps React Router's default error page away; a crash outside the route-level boundary now shows the existing 'unknown' ErrorState with Try again instead of a blank page.

GUARD: features/admin/shared/HeldWriteLeaveGuard.tsx, rendered once by AdminApp beside AppNoticeGate. useBlocker blocks only when: the session is authenticated (ref set during render), the registry reports an unsettled write, the pathname changes (same-path search changes pass), and the next path is not a public route (/login, /splash). shouldBlock reads the registry live (unsettledHeldWriteKeeping()), not the hook value, so a screen's own redirect after a confirmed write (useHeldDone in FundCreateScreen and ApplicationDetailScreen) passes: React runs the registry's effect cleanup before that navigate effect. If the hold settles or the session ends while the dialog is open, the dialog closes and the blocker resets (the admin stays on the page).

DIALOG: ConfirmDialog 'Stay on this page?'. Cancel 'Stay' (also Escape, scrim, Close, Android Back; the Close button takes first focus); confirm 'Leave anyway' (danger tone). Wording: if every unsettled hold is stored: 'A save is not confirmed yet. Leaving keeps it saved on this device, and you can come back to it later.' If any hold is on this page only: 'A save is not confirmed yet, and it is kept on this page only. If you leave, it cannot be checked again, so check the record before you enter it again.'

CORRECTION TO THE BRIEF (wording truth): the brief said holds persist. Many useHeldWrite callers pass no persistence: AppConfigBuilder publish, ApplicationDetail decide, ClientMaturitySection cancel, MaturityDateForm, MaturitySendDialog, MaturityConfirmDialog, MaturityResolveDialog, MaturityActions withdraw, SipEarlyExit, SipScheduleEditor, SipScheduleCreateForm, FundHoldings exit, and maybe others. Leaving those loses the idempotency key. So the registry now stores, per holder, whether the hold is kept on this page only. useHeldWrite reports page-only when hold !== null && !persisted. I avoided the brief's 'you can check it again later', because an expired or unreadable hold cannot be checked again.

ALSO: useUnloadGuard does not decide 'unsettled'. It fires only for unsaved holds (isUnsavedHold: held && !persisted) and the payment sheet's unsaved rows. As the brief's step 2 asks (pending and unreadable count), I used the p-lows registry's decision instead: hold !== null || unreadableAt !== null.

REGISTRY API (unsettledHeldWrites.ts): useMarkUnsettledHeldWrite(isUnsettled, isKeptOnPageOnly) (the second argument is new and required); unsettledHeldWriteKeeping(): 'none' | 'device' | 'page'; useUnsettledHeldWriteKeeping(); useHasUnsettledHeldWrite() is unchanged for AdminFrame (What's new) and MaturityDuePrompt.

PAYMENT SHEET (rule 15, sibling): its recorder never fed the registry. PaymentSheetScreen now calls useMarkUnsettledHeldWrite(waiting.size > 0, recorder.unsaved.size > 0), where waiting is held rows plus unreadable rows. Effects: in-app navigation away is guarded there too, and What's new and the maturity prompt now wait while sheet rows are unsettled. STATIC only, no dedicated test.

ANDROID BACK: no NativeBackCoordinator change. Its parentPath, home and navigate(-1) moves now go through the data router, so the blocker catches them (a POP is reverted by the router and replayed on proceed). Back with the dialog open closes it (dismissTop, so Stay). Not guarded: the exitApp branch, taken only on /overview, /login or /splash with no history. No admin screen there holds a write outside an overlay; frame-level held dialogs are overlays and dismissTop runs first.

COMPAT (rule 11, finding-14): no request or response shape, route, error code, header, cookie or stored key changes. The registry is memory only. Released client and admin APKs carry their own bundles; an images-only rollback restores the old frontend with nothing stored differently. The client bundle is unchanged in behaviour (BrowserRouter only moved up one component); cross-target check: none.

TESTS (rule 10), new file HeldWriteLeaveGuard.test.tsx. It uses a real SessionProvider, useHeldWrite, NativeBackCoordinator with the admin back policy and real admin route paths, inside createMemoryRouter. (1) A sidebar link with a never-persisted unknown hold opens the dialog ('kept on this page only'); Stay keeps the form; Leave anyway reaches Users. (2) No hold: the link passes. A confirmed write's own useHeldDone redirect passes. (3) Sign-out (signedOut then navigate to /login, as AdminFrame does) is never held, even with the held form still mounted outside RequireSession. (4) Android Back with a persisted hold opens the dialog ('saved on this device'); a second Back closes it; Back then Leave anyway reaches the parent /client-values.

TEST-ENV NOTE: the file stubs global Request to drop the signal. jsdom's AbortSignal fails undici's Request check inside React Router's data-router navigation, which is a known jsdom/Node mismatch. Browsers and the bundle boot check use matching classes. The stub is test-only, in this one file.

RED CONTROLS (each a mutation of my own fix; restored; cmp identical; tree clean after). The test file stayed as committed. RC-1 2b342064: useBlocker(false); test 1 fails (no dialog). RC-2 d93fd78c: the same mutation; test 4 fails. RC-3 39e4268e: registry check dropped from shouldBlock; test 2 fails at the no-hold link. RC-4 e18e849e: shouldBlock reads the closure's keeping instead of the live registry; test 2 fails at the confirmed-write redirect. RC-5 be015818: public-path exemption dropped; test 3 fails (sign-out stays on the form). RC-6 be32085b: useHeldWrite marks every hold as device-kept; test 1 fails at the page-only wording.

Frontend npm ci + check 91529279: 56 files, 488 tests, bundle boots with 7 chunks. build:client cc003e9d: android dist 17 assets, 960208 bytes; cross-target none; boot check passed. build:admin 5c058da9: boot check, 7 chunks. Backend not touched and not run.

RUNTIME STEPS FOR THE COORDINATOR (UNVERIFIED: no browser run here). (1) Admin web, /client-values/individual: choose an investor, block or drop the POST reply so the alert reads Not confirmed, then click another sidebar item. 'Stay on this page?' appears with the 'saved on this device' line (the growth hold is persisted); the URL is unchanged. Stay keeps the screen and its alert. Click again, then Leave anyway: the other page opens. Come back: the held alert is restored.

(2) A never-persisted write, e.g. a client page with 'Set a maturity date' held as Not confirmed, then click Users: the dialog shows the 'kept on this page only' line. (3) Browser Back button on a held screen: the same dialog, and the URL returns to the held page. (4) Sign out while held: lands on sign-in with no dialog. (5) Nothing held: links move freely. A successful Create fund still redirects to the new fund with no dialog. (6) Payment sheet with a held row: a sidebar click asks. (7) Android Back on the admin APK: covered by the unit test only. (8) The client app: no dialog anywhere (it has no blocker).

DOUBTFUL / LEFT: (a) Same-path search changes are not guarded (for example a ?userId change on the individual growth screen, or the payment sheet month or fund filter); those screens manage their own pickers, and finding-40's open picker items are separate. (b) The Android exitApp branch is not guarded (see above). (c) A crash outside the route boundary now shows ErrorState instead of a blank page, a small visible change. (d) Plan section 8 entry, the review and closing any finding are the coordinator's (rule-50).
